premises.text: Africa has a shortage of developers and few children leave school with basic computer science knowledge
premises.evidence_span: Africa suffers from what I would love to call SOD, shortage of developers

premises.text: Children need to become creators of technology through early coding education
premises.evidence_span: These children need not only be passive consumers of technology, but also become creators and innovators of it

premises.text: bBlocky teaches programming fundamentals via game puzzles and graphical programming blocks for kids
premises.evidence_span: bBlocky lets children learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles

premises.text: Lessons use game scenes and AR to make learning interactive, with coins unlocking characters
premises.evidence_span: Every lesson starts with instructions, then with a game scene, which is either a normal game scene or an AR

premises.text: App works fully offline for low-internet African regions while remaining globally relevant
premises.evidence_span: our application works fully offline, ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

premises.text: Revenue from in-app character store and branded-character placements

value.text: Kids learn coding early through fun, accessible tools so they can build technology
